analog.edition: 1982 with amendment 1; valid in Russia on 2026-11-14

statuses.PASS: source-scoped rule only, not blanket production APPROVED
statuses.FAIL: explicit contradicted universal normative assertion or forbidden clean export
statuses.BLOCKED: insufficient cited permission/verified full-source figure match

cases.positive_example: DD1 true power/nonlogical lead LEFT, correct Vcc/GND, real PinRef
cases.negative_example: claim power MUST always be left
mandatory: nonlogical input line may lie left; label/physical pin correctly mapped

cases.positive_example: real nonlogical VCC on RIGHT with intact physical mapping
cases.negative_example: ban right-side power just because Fig6 draws left
mandatory: nonlogical lead may lie right; labels and numbers authentic

cases.positive_example: show top VCC only as experimental nonnormative editor view
cases.negative_example: claim §2.1.6 allows automatic VCC_TOP in fixed LEFT_RIGHT portrait
mandatory: no established universal TOP rule for nonlogical pin in unchanged portrait
cases.release_blocker: independent normative diagram for fixed TOP power absent

cases.positive_example: show bottom GND only as editor DRAFT variant
cases.negative_example: claim GND must be below simply because ground potential is low
mandatory: no universal BOTTOM rule for nonlogical lead in unchanged portrait
cases.release_blocker: source does not affirm supply-only relocation to bottom

cases.positive_example: source-matched whole element with TOP inputs/BOTTOM outputs, power separately validated
cases.negative_example: cite whole UGO rotation as automatic license to change just VCC side
mandatory: signal input/output layout and reversed-flow arrows/source function
cases.release_blocker: specific POWER top/bottom remains unapproved without matching original

cases.positive_example: DD1 common control block includes +5V and 0V roles
cases.negative_example: invent additional physical device for common control block
mandatory: same physical IC identity and contact inventory

cases.positive_example: DD3 supply contour + DD3.1/2/3 logic share one physical IC
cases.negative_example: use 6б+6в simultaneously and claim arbitrary combination
cases.release_blocker: full cross-unit cold reopen with actual pin map pending

cases.positive_example: DD2.1 hosts power display; DD2.2/3 same real package
cases.negative_example: repeat same power PhysicalPin in every DD2 unit
mandatory: 6a+6b documented drawing-set policy; unique physical PinRef

cases.positive_example: clear sheet text DD1 physical pin 14 +5V and pin 7 0V, verified external datasheet
cases.negative_example: free-floating +5V text with unknown device/pin fabricated into net
mandatory: unambiguous text assignment to true part/pin
cases.release_blocker: actual manufacturer pin assignment required for concrete IC

cases.negative_example: say arbitrary mixing 6б and 6в is source-approved

cases.positive_example: true power label Vcc, VCC on computer-output or allowed U; GND/common label from actual part
cases.negative_example: VCC text creates phantom electrical connection or is a package number
mandatory: use table5 marks contextually; distinct nets and physical numbers

cases.positive_example: DA supply U, allowed V with nominal, letter-O common OV
cases.negative_example: treat analog OV letters as digit 0V voltage or impose GND default as sole table2 label
mandatory: analog inherits 2.743; U/OV and input/output profile as given

cases.positive_example: actual number above L/R lead or permitted gap, unique source PinRef
cases.negative_example: use text Vcc itself as number or duplicate physical supply pin
cases.release_blocker: real datasheet pin number required for production part

cases.positive_example: fixed portrait body L/R with horizontal PWM as function, documented meaning
cases.negative_example: claim PWM in table2 without source or clip word
mandatory: function first main-field line, actual ink and correct fields

cases.positive_example: opt-in word-only 90° as DRAFT editor display, unchanged pins
cases.negative_example: claim fig3 universally allows rotating ONLY PWM in unchanged L/R rectangle
mandatory: no independently proven 90 word-only normative profile
cases.release_blocker: source proof for arbitrary text-only 90 absent

cases.negative_example: claim §2.1.9 readability implies permission for any 270-only word

cases.positive_example: clean drawing without any editor-only green hotspot overlays
cases.negative_example: print editor green squares as mandatory ГОСТ junctions
mandatory: clean release does not print interactive targets; project invariant
editorial: color and CSS hit radius are editor-only

cases.clause: Issue #100 / editor policy; not a ГОСТ-required symbol
cases.positive_example: explicit opt-in green rect at true Point and PinRef, NC disabled
cases.negative_example: hover creates Net, extra pin or electrical short
mandatory: read-only target, explicit overlay enabled, no net mutation

cases.positive_example: clean and diagnostic views preserve identical physical pins and Circuit.Net
